note: The HDR render target and the resolve pass. Two halves, judged two ways. The orbsim_view half -- the sRGB transfer function and the scene's clear colour -- is judged by test_srgb against 50-digit references. The src/render half and the shaders cannot be reached from tests/, so their mutants build the application and are judged by orbsim_smoke, which since M1-14 runs synchronization validation as well as the base layers. **Several render mutants are declared survivors, and they share one cause**: nothing reads a pixel back before M1-16, so a resolve pass that draws the wrong thing -- or nothing -- is a valid Vulkan program. The shader's encode and the two 'not supported' paths were accepted in advance by the owner on 2026-09-24 (M1-14 question 10); the other survivors of the same cause were found by this pass and accepted by the owner on 2026-09-25 (decision 171). M1-16's probe frames and M1-18's port check are what must kill them, and whoever closes those tasks re-runs these mutants and removes the declarations. **Run once on 2026-09-24: 10 caught, 6 survived as declared, 0 invalid, 2 hung.** The two hung mutants make renderer start-up fail, and a failed start-up opens a message box that waits for a click, so orbsim_smoke hangs rather than fails -- a defect older than M1-14 that nothing had reached before. The owner ruled on 2026-09-25 (decision 170) that an automated run -- one with --seconds -- shows no dialog; the pass was then run again.

mutants.name: the power segment uses the gamma-2.2 exponent
the knee itself is encoded on the power segment
the decode raises to the encode's exponent
the encode lets a negative value through
the scene clears to the display value instead of the light
the HDR target is left as a colour attachment for the resolve pass
a barrier waits for nothing before it
the device is not idle before the resolve pass is destroyed
the descriptor names the wrong layout for the HDR target
the HDR format check refuses a format the device supports
the swapchain check refuses a UNORM format
the HDR format check never reports
mutants.why: The refusal can only be reached on a device without a format the Vulkan specification makes mandatory, and this machine has none. Accepted in advance by the owner on 2026-09-24 (M1-14 question 10). The mutant above, which makes the check refuse a supported format, shows the check is wired in.

mutants.name: the swapchain check accepts any colour space
mutants.why: Both of this machine's surfaces offer B8G8R8A8_UNORM in the sRGB colour space first, so the refusal cannot be reached here. Accepted in advance by the owner on 2026-09-24 (M1-14 question 10).

mutants.name: the tonemap shader encodes with the gamma-2.2 exponent
mutants.why: The GPU's encode is a second implementation that nothing reads back before M1-16; M1-18 compares it with view/Srgb.hpp to 1/255. Accepted in advance by the owner on 2026-09-24 (M1-14 question 10).

mutants.name: the scene pipelines are built for the swapchain's format
mutants.why: Vulkan compares a pipeline's formats with the attachments only when it draws, and nothing is drawn before M1-19. This is exactly the edit kHdrFormat's named constant exists to make unlikely; M1-19's first draw kills it. Found by this pass on 2026-09-24 and accepted by the owner on 2026-09-25 (register decision 171), on the same grounds as the gaps accepted in advance.

mutants.name: the resolve pass is never drawn
mutants.why: The display is then cleared to black and nothing else: a valid program, and nothing reads a pixel back before M1-16, whose tonemapped PNG kills it. Found by this pass on 2026-09-24 and accepted by the owner on 2026-09-25 (register decision 171), on the same grounds as the gaps accepted in advance.

mutants.name: the full-screen triangle covers a quarter of the screen
mutants.why: A smaller triangle is valid Vulkan, and the uncovered part is the resolve pass's black clear; nothing reads a pixel back before M1-16, whose probe frames kill it. Found by this pass on 2026-09-24 and accepted by the owner on 2026-09-25 (register decision 171), on the same grounds as the gaps accepted in advance.
